description: Download an economic time series as rows (long format: date, value) with its citation and license. REQUIRES the free ElkassabgiData API key. Use date_from/date_to to window long series.

date_from.description: Start of the date window to return, as an ISO date (inclusive).

date_to.description: End of the date window to return, as an ISO date (inclusive).

max_rows.description: Maximum number of data rows to return.

series_id.description: Exact catalog id from search_econ_series, e.g. 'worldbank:NY.GDP.MKTP.CD:DEU'

name: get_econ_series
title: Download Economic Series
